fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (2330) stock price plummeted below NT$2,000, yet is rated as the top choice of Motley Fool analysts among AI chip holdings to hold through 2030, offering a buying opportunity for long-term investors.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC holds approximately 73% of the global foundry market share (Samsung #2 at ~6%), and approximately 90% market share in advanced process areas, making it difficult for competitors to catch up.
